units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 43:2">Ex. R. s. 43</cite> (ref. to <he>יפיחו</he>, <cite ref="Proverbs 29:8">Prov. XXIX, 8</cite>) <he>אלו ישראל שנתנו פ׳ בעולם וכ׳</he> this means the Israelites who brought diminution into the world by the calf which they made, for … there is not a generation that suffers not at least a particle of punishment &c. (v. <cite ref="A00765"><he>אוּנְקְיָא</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:17:1">Cant. R. to II, 17</cite> (play on <he>שיפוח</he>, <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:17:1">ib.</cite>) <he>עד שאכניס פ׳ בלילן של מלכיות</he> until I allow a reduction to enter into the sufferings (v. <cite ref="L00466"><he>לַיִל</he></cite>) from foreign governments, i.e. shorten the term of the exile.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:17:1">Ib.</cite> <he>כבר הכנסתי פ׳ וכ׳</he> I did once before shorten the exile in Egypt.
